shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat slab/panel
horizontal register bands dividing the surface
row of repeated geometric/triangular or chevron motifs forming a band
justification: Both are low-relief panels organised into horizontal registers with a band of repeated triangular/zigzag motifs and profile creatures, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows isolated, widely spaced animals (birds, quadrupeds, a snake-like form) on a bare ground with no interaction, whereas B is a densely packed, symmetrical scene of costumed anthropomorphic figures flanking a central tree with scrolling volute filler, so the specific subject matter, density and compositional logic are quite different.
